header: The Gemini reading check of a circular's pages: for each page the pipeline already read (its reading comes from the re-read tool's page cache), a second reader (Gemini) reads the same page image, I compare the two readings (readingCheck.ts), and a report ranks the pages to look at.

I keep Gemini's readings on disk, so a page is never paid for twice; a failed or incomplete reading is never kept. The calls are spaced out, a rate-limit refusal waits for the window to clear, and a run stops after a limit on live calls, so one command cannot burn the quota. Nothing here touches the database: it reads, compares and reports.

behaviours: a page where every important number agrees is 'agreed'
the gate pass is 'differences'
...and the pin code the pipeline read as 13203 is caught
each flagged number comes with the words around it
the full readings are kept only when asked
the wage notice keeps its three daily wages confirmed
one pause after each LIVE call
live calls are counted
an empty reading is skipped, with the reason given
...and a default reason is given when none was
a skipped page makes no call
a second run reads nothing from Gemini
...and gives the same answers
...and does not pause for a saved reading
a different model reads the page again
the saved reading is one file per page, in a gemini/ folder
the file name depends on the page, the reader and the instructions
with the saved readings switched off, the page is read again
a reading that stopped early is 'partial', not a disagreement
an incomplete reading is read again next time (it was not kept)
a failed page is an error, and the next page is still read
a real error does not wait for the rate limit
a rate-limit refusal waits and then succeeds
...and the waits go through the injected clock (the test itself does not wait)
a rate limit that does not clear stops the run and says so
the run stops at the limit on live calls
with keepTexts the outcome carries both full readings
...but the JSON report does not hold them
the summary counts the pages
the report lists the pages that need a look, with the numbers and the page image
the page with more differences comes first
the report shows the words around the flagged numbers
a '|' in a headline cannot break the table
the report says that the check itself writes nothing
the JSON carries the meta, the summary and every circular
a stopped run says so in the report
